title: WebCoder: Scaling General Frontend Development with Artifact-Grounded Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23104v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world frontend development requires agents to compose reproduction, generation, modification, and repair over an evolving application state. Learning a general policy for this process requires translating heterogeneous execution feedback into task-aligned rewards and effective credit assignment across long sequences of interdependent actions. We introduce WebCoder, a general frontend development agent trained with artifact-grounded agentic reinforcement learning. Our key idea is to assess diverse development activities through their effects on a shared executable artifact and its satisfaction of task requirements. We build Webdev-World, an executable environment that integrates code editing, application execution, browser inspection, and on-demand skills while preserving project state across interactions. translated_title: WebCoder：基于工件锚定的智能体强化学习扩展通用前端开发
translated_abstract: 现实世界的前端开发要求智能体能够在不断演进的应用状态上完成复现、生成、修改和修复等多种操作的组合。为这一过程学习一个通用策略，需要将异构的执行反馈转化为与任务对齐的奖励，并在长序列的相互依赖的动作之间实现有效的信用分配。我们提出了WebCoder，一个通过工件锚定的智能体强化学习训练而成的通用前端开发智能体。我们的核心思想是：通过多样化的开发活动对同一个共享可执行工件所产生的影响，以及该工件对任务需求的满足程度，来评估这些开发活动。我们构建了Webdev-World，这是一个可执行环境，集成了代码编辑、应用执行、浏览器检查和按需调用的技能，并在交互过程中保持项目状态的连续性。一个独立的验证器会根据任务需求对最终应用进行评估，以提供终止奖励，同时……
tldr: WebCoder提出工件锚定的智能体强化学习方法，通过可执行环境Webdev-World和依据最终应用是否满足任务需求的独立验证奖励，训练出能完成前端复现、生成、修改与修复的通用开发智能体。
en_tdlr: WebCoder trains a general frontend development agent via artifact-grounded agentic reinforcement learning, using an executable environment (Webdev-World) with an independent verifier that rewards agents based on how well the final application satisfies task requirements, enabling reproduction, generation, modification, and repair of frontend applications.
